story.text: 며칠 전 비를 맞은 게 화근이었다. 아침부터 목이 따끔거리고 몸이 무거웠다.
story.reading: myeo-chil jeon bi-reul maj-eun ge hwa-geun-i-eot-da. a-chim-bu-teo mok-i tta-kkeum-geo-ri-go mom-i mu-geo-wot-da.
story.en: Getting caught in the rain a few days ago was the cause. My throat had been prickling and my body felt heavy since morning.

story.text: '너 얼굴이 왜 그래.' 하늘이 대뜸 손을 뻗어 내 이마를 짚었다. '많이 아프네.'
story.reading: 'neo eol-gul-i wae geu-rae.' ha-neul-i dae-tteum son-eul ppeot-eo nae i-ma-reul jip-eot-da. 'man-i a-peu-ne.'
story.en: "Why do you look like that?" Haneul reached out without warning and pressed his hand to my forehead. "You're pretty sick."

story.text: '병원 가자. 근처에 내가 아는 곳 있어.' 그는 대답도 듣지 않고 벌써 걷기 시작했다.
story.reading: 'byeong-won ga-ja. geun-cheo-e nae-ga a-neun got iss-eo.' geu-neun dae-dap-do deut-ji anh-go beol-sseo geot-gi si-jak-haet-da.
story.en: "Let's go to the hospital. I know a place nearby." He didn't even wait for an answer, already walking ahead.

story.text: 진료를 마치고 나오자, 의사가 처방전을 건넸다. 하늘이 대신 받아 접어 주머니에 넣었다.
story.reading: jil-lyo-reul ma-chi-go na-o-ja, ui-sa-ga cheo-bang-jeon-eul geon-ne-ss-da. ha-neul-i dae-sin bad-a jeob-eo ju-meo-ni-e neoh-eot-da.
story.en: After the exam, the doctor handed over a prescription. Haneul took it for me, folded it, and tucked it into his pocket.

story.text: '약국은 저 건너편이야.' 그가 길을 건너며 내 팔을 슬쩍 붙잡았다. 차가 오는 방향을 살피면서.
story.reading: 'yak-guk-eun jeo geon-neo-pyeon-i-ya.' geu-ga gil-eul geon-neo-myeo nae pal-eul seul-jjeok but-jab-at-da. cha-ga o-neun bang-hyang-eul sal-pi-myeon-seo.
story.en: "The pharmacy's right across there." He caught my arm lightly as we crossed, keeping an eye on the traffic.

story.text: '하루 세 번, 밥 먹고 바로 먹어.' 약 봉투를 건네며 그가 짧게 일렀다.
story.reading: 'ha-ru se beon, bap meok-go ba-ro meog-eo.' yak bong-tu-reul geon-ne-myeo geu-ga jjalb-ge il-leot-da.
story.en: "Three times a day, right after meals." He instructed briefly, handing over the bag of medicine.

story.text: '고마워.' 내가 웃으며 말하자, 그는 괜히 딴 데를 보며 중얼거렸다. '아프지나 마.'
story.reading: 'go-ma-wo.' nae-ga us-eu-myeo mal-ha-ja, geu-neun gwaen-hi ttan de-reul bo-myeo jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. 'a-peu-ji-na ma.'
story.en: "Thanks." I said with a smile. He looked away for no reason and mumbled, "Just don't get sick again."

words.example_en: I think I need to go to the hospital.

words.example: 이 약을 하루에 세 번 드세요.
words.example_reading: i yag-eul ha-ru-e se beon deu-se-yo
words.example_en: Take this medicine three times a day.

sentences.en: Let's go to the hospital together.
